verdict.rationale: Managing automations is a fair question for a GitHub client that surfaces Copilot agent tasks, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows GitHub Mobile versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations. The pack documents agent task tracking and PR review on mobile, and scheduled or event-driven automations on the broader GitHub platform. Neither is a documented capability to keep revision history of automations, review changes to them, or roll them back.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
